No. 716
Date 16/11/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

November 16th 191

Sir,

There will be a meeting in the painters guild
on Park Road at 2 p.m. to-day.
Zau Kya Ziang 曹新洋 who came to investigate the
sinking of s.s. "Sing Yui" as a result of a collision
with the cruiser "Hai Yung", The guns on the cruiser
"Ching Tsing" 镜清 now lying in the Whangpoo near
the Arsenal, have been taken ashore. The cause
of this action has not been given out.
Forty two passage tickets were handed to
rebels by General Li Tsung Woo 李徵之 on 15th inst.
The troops in the vicinity of Shanghai have not
yet received their wages. They are usually paid
on the 8th or 9th of each month.

Your Obedient Servant,

WBrewster

Detective Sub Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事调查处
情报科登记
编号 716
日期 1916年11月16日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

191 年11月16日

先生：

今日下午二时，在派克路（Park Road）的油漆业公会内将举行一次会议。

曹新洋（Zau Kya Ziang）前来调查因与巡洋舰“海容”号（Hai Yung）相撞而沉没的商船“新裕”号（Sing Yui）一事。目前停泊在兵工厂附近黄浦江上的巡洋舰“镜清”号（Ching Tsing）上的火炮已被卸至岸上。此举的原因尚未公布。

本月15日，李徵之（Li Tsung Woo）将军向叛乱分子分发了四十二张船票。

上海附近的部队尚未领到薪饷。他们通常在每月的8日或9日发薪。

您顺从的仆人，

W. Brewster

侦探副督察。

警察总监
